source: Gower Street Analytics monthly global box office posts on gower.st/articles (Global Box Office Tracker), hand-entered
period_rule: period = the calendar month the post reports, YYYY-MM

units.global_usd: worldwide theatrical box office for the month in US dollars at current exchange rates, as Gower Street states it (rounded by them to $10-100 million)

note: Gower Street's terms forbid automated data collection from gower.st, so this file is filled by hand: each row carries the post URL, its publication date and the sentence (or title) the figure was read from. method 'stated' = the monthly figure appears in the post; 'title' = only the headline states it; 'derived' = the post gives only year-to-date cumes and the month is the difference of two stated cumes (rounded to $0.1 billion, so +/- $0.1 billion) and is flagged preliminary. Gower Street revises its estimates in later posts (the July 2023 record is quoted as $4.54bn, $4.61bn and $4.639bn across posts); this file keeps the figure as first posted.
